Through the genocide in Gaza and the Iran war, Israel has shown how AI has been completely subsumed into the economy of war. AI companies will work with anyone — and their collaboration with the imperialist powers of the world looks set to expand.

Video

Globalization created long supply chains that span  entire seas. Their length and complexity made them vulnerable to major disruption — something Iran is making clear in the Strait of Hormuz. Watch Richard Wolff's breakdown: piped.video/watch?v=dWMkTFR6…

This article was originally published at my Substack. To continue my independent journalism, I depend on the generosity and support of my readers. If you'd like to support me directly, you can do so at my Substack: chrishedges.substack.com Thank you for all your support.

The ill-conceived US war on Iran is leading the world to a global recession or depression. Professor Richard Wolff places the current crisis in the context of the capitalist system and the decline of US hegemonic power on the latest episode of CHR.

Link: piped.video/watch?v=sv61bqSe…

Throughout its long war on Iran, every tactic used by the United States has backfired. Professor Behrooz Ghamari-Tabrizi explains why Iran’s revolutionary spirit remains strong on the latest episode of The Chris Hedges Report. 

Link: piped.video/watch?v=i5rlfQ0G…

.@normfinkelstein has recently taken issue with the characterization by figures like Tucker Carlson and Candace Owens of the Trump-Israeli relationship primarily being driven by "blackmail." On my last Q&A, I briefly broke down the complexities of how Israel exerts influence on the American political system, primarily via legalized bribery (but still including blackmail).

Video
Watch my full Q&A on Iran on YouTube: piped.video/watch?v=HDSeOPAh…

Will the U.S. withdraw from the Middle East? Perhaps — but not voluntarily. Iran has shown to the world the weak points in the Empire's seemingly hegemonic presence in the region. If exploited successfully by its adversaries, we could the dollar cease to be the world reserve currency, tanking America's global standing.
